content.short: Sick City is a Cardano NFT creator project offering custom minting, music Web3 support, and art tools.
content.description: Sick City is a Cardano NFT and creator services project that combines custom minting, music-focused Web3 support, stake pool activity, and original art. The project has helped release many NFT projects and tokens for its community, with an emphasis on giving artists and musicians a practical path into Cardano. Sick City is best understood as a creator-led minting and community platform rather than only a single collection, because it supports both its own art and outside project launches for creators.
content.meta: Sick City offers Cardano NFT minting, music Web3 support, and creator services for artists. Explore the project on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
